---
title: Speaker invitation
---

Send this after a speaker accepts the first invitation. In 2027 we sent it on 1 December and asked for replies by 5 January.

**Subject:** AfricaNLP [YEAR]: details for your talk

```text
Dear [Name],

Thank you for agreeing to speak at the AfricaNLP workshop at [HOST YEAR].
To finish the schedule, we need a few details from you:

- Time slot: do you prefer morning or afternoon?
- Format: will you join us in person or present online?
- Sponsorship: do you need support for travel or conference registration?
  We can fund the workshop portion only.
- Talk: each talk has 40 minutes, 35 to present and 5 for questions.
  Please send a tentative title, an abstract, a short bio and a headshot.

Please reply by [date].

Best regards,
[Name]
AfricaNLP Organizing Committee
```
